name: google-chrome-stable

storage.rationale: This host tool has no Vrooli-owned persistent storage; Chrome profile and cache data remain owned by the invoking workflow.

description: Optional headless Chromium-compatible browser used for high-fidelity SVG rasterization
installHint: Install Google Chrome, Chromium, or another compatible headless browser manually; image-tools also accepts IMAGE_TOOLS_CHROME_BINARY.
notes: The runtime probes the command aliases in declaration order. No automatic package mapping is declared because image-tools supports multiple browser distributions and explicit binary overrides.
